behavior.name: Sciurus17 Example Behavior
behavior.author: Lotfi El Hafi
behavior.description: Example of a FlexBE behavior that implements a looping dual-arm dance for a Sciurus17 robot. The right arm and left arm alternately move to their respective 'init_pose' named configurations defined in the SRDF, with a configurable wait time between moves.

param.name: wait_time
param.label: wait_time
param.hint: Sets the wait_time between arm moves (seconds)
